display.usage: All Headings (H1-H6), structural titles, modal titles.

body.usage: Body text, UI elements, navigation, narrative text, form labels.

mono.usage: Every number, data points, stats, timestamps, metrics, audit logs.

quiet.description: Light, narrative zone (~60% of layout). Warm-tinted off-whites, never cold grey.

operational.description: Dark, data zone (~40% of layout). Warm espresso/black, never cold grey.

accent.description: One coral accent signal per composition. Use strictly for primary CTA or critical AI signal.

rules: NO DECORATIVE COLORS. Everything communicates state or hierarchy.
Never use generic default grays (slate, gray, zinc). Stick to the warm-tinted variables.
The coral accent MUST be the only vivid color on the screen.

layouts.global_architecture: Two-Register Split Screen. The screen is physically split into two distinct thematic zones.

quiet_field.content: Navigation, Activity timeline, AI Chat panel ('Ask your pipeline anything'), high-level narratives, Contacts overview.

operational_zone.content: Data-dense tables, Dynamic Field builder ('Use AI' column), Deal pipelines (Kanban), precise data editing, audit logs.

layouts.spacing: Dense but legible. Use standard Tailwind spacing but rely on strict borders rather than massive padding for separation. 1px borders define structure.

tables_and_grids.headers: font-body text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-muted border-b border-border.
tables_and_grids.cells: font-mono text-sm (if numbers/data) or font-body text-sm (if text).
tables_and_grids.ai_column: The 'Use AI' column should have a subtle coral top border or indicator to signify dynamic enrichment.
tables_and_grids.borders: 1px solid (Quiet or Operational border color based on zone). No rounded corners on internal table cells.

buttons.primary: bg-accent-primary text-white font-body font-medium px-4 py-2 hover:bg-accent-hover transition-colors rounded-sm
buttons.secondary_quiet: bg-quiet-surface text-quiet-text border border-quiet-border hover:bg-quiet-border transition-colors rounded-sm
buttons.secondary_operational: bg-operational-surface text-operational-text border border-operational-border hover:bg-operational-border transition-colors rounded-sm

kanban_board.cards: Flat, non-elevated (no drop shadows). Rely on background color contrast and borders.
kanban_board.typography: Deal values in JetBrains Mono. Titles in IBM Plex Sans.

inputs_and_fields.borders: Bottom border only (flair-less) OR strict rectangle with 1px border. No heavy rounded corners.

visual_enhancers.shadows: DO NOT USE SHADOWS. The aesthetic is 'operational clarity built on restraint'. Use 1px borders and background contrast to separate elements.
visual_enhancers.borders: Sharp or slightly rounded (rounded-sm max). 1px solid lines define all relationships.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Banned. Keep surfaces solid and matter-of-fact.

motion.philosophy: Instantaneous and matter-of-fact. No decorative bouncing.
motion.transitions: Fast fades (150ms) for hover states. Snap transitions for structural changes.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure strict APCA/WCAG AA compliance. Dark zone text must be #E6E4DF on #1A1918. Light zone text must be #2C2B29 on #F9F8F6.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='ai-enrich-button').

instructions_to_main_agent.tech_stack: React.js (use .jsx or .js files ONLY, NO .tsx/.ts), Tailwind CSS, Shadcn UI (adapted to JS).
instructions_to_main_agent.theme_implementation: Configure Tailwind config with custom colors 'quiet', 'operational', and 'coral' (accent). Create a rigid layout split where Left ~60% uses quiet palette and Right ~40% uses operational palette.
instructions_to_main_agent.typography_implementation: Import IBM Plex Sans, DM Sans, and JetBrains Mono from Google Fonts in index.css. Apply strictly based on the defined roles.
instructions_to_main_agent.shadcn_customization: Strip Shadcn components of rounded corners (make them sharp or max rounded-sm) and drop shadows. Override standard gray defaults with the custom warm monochrome palettes.
instructions_to_main_agent.data_density: Tables must be compact, padding reduced. Data operations feel like a terminal or sophisticated spreadsheet.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing_ids: Inject data-testid attributes on every interactive element (buttons, tabs, inputs, table rows).
universal_guidelines: Avoid the generic 'AI slop' aesthetic. No emojis as icons. Use Phosphor Icons or Lucide.
Never center-align the main app container.
No transparent backgrounds for headers or dropdowns to preserve legibility.
Apply transitions only to specific properties (e.g., color, background), NEVER use 'transition-all'.
